text: The program emphasizes a co-funding model with a 3:1 government-to-council cost-sharing ratio, incentivizing local co-investment. It funds a range of activities, including planning, design, property modification, flood modification, and response modification measures. The program is part of the broader NSW Floodplain Management Grants framework and is administered by the NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW).

metadata.solution_name: NSW Flood Recovery and Resilience Grant Program
